title: Low-Calorie Friendly Venezuelan Casabe Stew
description: A rich, dense stew featuring casabe, perfect for a midnight craving, made in a traditional Kazan-cauldron with a low-calorie twist.
instructions: Heat oil in a Kazan-cauldron over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and saut5 until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, casabe, black beans, and chopped cilantro. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Reheat the stew gently before serving, if needed.
Discard any uneaten stew after 3 days and refrigerate or freeze for later use.
